name: revised_fields_with_openness
hypothesis: The E03 site-resolved chemical-field signal is useful only when conditioned on structural regime. Adding robust openness and normalized-contact controls should prevent sparse-cell extrapolation while retaining local chemical-organization information.
scope: Revision of E03 for all variable-size periodic cells. It retains eight site/contact chemistry summaries and adds log1p(volume/N), log1p(E6/N), smooth coordination, and weighted mean q. Contact weight remains exp(-(q/1.20)^6); q=d/(r_cov,i+r_cov,j); denominator floors are 0.1 A, 1e-6, or 1e-12 as shown.
falsification: Falsified as a revision if it does not lower adaptive formation MAE below E03's 0.311338 eV/atom. Hull support additionally requires logloss below E03's 0.552747; a tradeoff will motivate task-specific selection rather than a universal descriptor claim.
